name: Shinonome Utano
source:
She is the club president of Kotonoha Circle and Tomoki's senior at school. She comes to the clubroom faster than any of the club members, and enjoys watching Tomoki arrive at the clubroom. 

A beautiful girl that every student recognizes and respects, though the person herself doesn't really mind. 

She is always a guiding principle for Tomoki.

She likes the universe, is curious about unidentifiable riddle of Far Fireworks.

[Edited From the [url=https://en.u-ena.com/character]official website[/url]]
